**A car bomb near the presidential palace in [[Mogadishu]] kills at least 16 people and injures more than 20 others. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/22/al-shabaab-fatal-mogadishu-somalia-car-bomb (''The Guardian'')]

;Arts and culture
*[[Simcha Rotem]], the last surviving fighter of the 1943 [[Warsaw Ghetto Uprising]], also a participant in the 1944 [[Warsaw Uprising]], dies at the age of 94. [https://www.dw.com/en/last-warsaw-ghetto-uprising-fighter-dies/a-46845325 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Sunda Strait tsunami]]
**At least 281 people are killed and over 1,000 injured when a [[tsunami]] triggered by [[Krakatoa]]'s eruption hits the coast near [[Indonesia]]'s [[Sunda Strait]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-46663158 (BBC)] [https://www.cnn.com/2018/12/22/asia/deadly-tsunami-indonesia/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*The draft of a [[Constitution of Cuba#Proposed 2018 constitution|new constitution]] is approved by the [[National Assembly of People's Power|parliament]] of [[Cuba]]. It will be put up for referendum on February 24, 2019. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cuba-constitution/cuban-parliament-green-lights-new-constitution-heads-to-referendum-idUSKCN1OL0OF (Reuters)]
*The [[United States Department of State]] confirms Special Presidential Envoy for the [[International military intervention against ISIL|Global Coalition to Counter ISIL]] [[Brett McGurk]]'s resignation, effective December 31. [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump|Trump]] describes the resignation as a "nothing event". [https://apnews.com/a6be8c68c6b147549083da125d118446 (Associated Press)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-46661384 (BBC)]
